intent: A ruin priestess's pale ruin-stone gown, black-corseted under a dark green cinch with a bone girdle and lichen frill, the skirt flaring panel by panel to a moss-eaten, lichen-frilled hem, dark moss sleeves held close to the arm, and a low moss-and-bone crown of bone points and bracket-fungus shelves; from the high camera it reads as a narrow pale bodice over a wide flaring bell under a low mossy crown.
requests: A tapered part (or a wedge that widens with height) so a skirt can flare smoothly across the thigh and knee instead of stepping through stacked boxes.
A soft flared-ring piece for frills and ruffles, so a fungal-gill hem is one part rather than a ring of boxes.
